paper_title: D-QBF with Few Existential Variables Revisited
classifications: Theory of computation → Fixed parameter tractability
statement: The main contribution of this paper is to resolve the open problem of [7] by showing that even for QBFs of arity 4 the double-exponential dependence of the running time on k is necessary. This leaves open as an intriguing open question the case of QBFs of arity 3. We conjecture that it should be possible to extend our lower bound to this case. Furthermore, we showed that the complexity of d-QBF parameterized by k does become significantly better if we only allow two quantifier blocks (∀∃-QBF), as in this case we have an algorithm with parameter dependence exponential in k d−1 , rather than double-exponential in k. On the other hand, our double-exponential lower bound requires a small but unbounded number of quantifier alternations to work (roughly log log n, as each step of our construction √ replaces a formula of size m with one of size O( m)). This leaves open the question of what happens for a small but constant number of alternations. Namely, is the complexity of solving ∀∃∀∃-QBF already double-exponential in k?
